questions.q: Which dinosaur is the famous 'tyrant lizard king'?

questions.why: Small, speedy and feathered. Much smaller than the movies show.

questions.q: T. rex and Velociraptor ran on…
questions.why: Two strong back legs, with tiny arms!

questions.q: Which dinosaur had a super long neck?
questions.why: Brachiosaurus reached up high like a giraffe.

questions.q: What did long-necked dinosaurs munch on?
Tall long-necks were among the ___ land animals ever.
questions.why: Some were longer than three buses!

questions.q: How many horns did Triceratops have?
questions.why: Two over the eyes and one on the nose. Tri-cera-tops!

questions.q: What is the big bony shield on its head called?
questions.why: The frill helped protect its neck.

questions.q: Which dinosaur had back plates and a spiky tail?
questions.why: Stegosaurus: plates on its back, spikes on its tail.

questions.q: Ankylosaurus had a tail like a…
What are Stegosaurus tail spikes called?
questions.why: Thagomizer. Yes, that is a real word!
Pterosaurs were flying reptiles, close cousins of dinosaurs.

questions.q: Which animals are living dinosaurs today?
questions.why: Birds come from small feathered dinosaurs!
